name: Pull request diff-first review discipline
description: Inspect changed files and diffs of pull requests before drawing review conclusions.
applies_when: performing code review on changed files
does_not_apply_when: purely administrative requests with no code changes
instructions: Fetch and inspect changed files and diffs before stating review conclusions.
Confirm code changes include matching test coverage.
anti_patterns: Approving based only on pull request title or description.
